failureCounting.note: HTTPS counts include the failed parent; repeated failure-report lines in logs are not additional failed tests.

failures.test: Chrome 320px: both roles edit their public profile with the keyboard, translated labels and focus restored to the opener
failures.confirmedCause: The fixture asserted the superseded picker contract.
failures.fixtureCorrection: Update only the expected accept string to the actual supported contract.

failures.test: Chrome: real avatar crop, private preview cleanup on controlled hiding, explicit upload/save and peer initials after removal
failures.observed: Timed out: actual browser JPEG decode and central 256px crop.
failures.confirmedCause: The avatar helper injected FileList/change without opening the real chooser, so the opening-bound intent guard rejected the synthetic selection before preparation.
failures.fixtureCorrection: Invoke the real profile chooser handler while intercepting and restoring only input.click for the OS dialog; require that native call was requested, then provide the real DataTransfer/FileList/change. Keep real decoding, private reads and explicit upload/save.

failures.test: Chrome personal reply lost acknowledgement never retries automatically and explicit reload reveals the saved reply
failures.observed: Immediately after Escape, personal-reply-body remained 'Confirmation perdue'; expected ''. The log did not record dialog.open.
failures.confirmedFixtureGap: The assertion read the field after the key action without waiting for the native dialog close event. Source preserves the draft on explicit reload and clears it in the close handler.
failures.diagnosticLimit: The first log alone does not prove the exact native close-event timing or a product defect. The correction retains a bounded check for complete closure and private-field cleanup, so a genuine failure to close remains detectable.
failures.fixtureCorrection: Assert 'Confirmation perdue' is preserved after explicit GET reload; send real Escape; wait until the dialog is closed AND the field is empty; retain the assertion that only one uncertain POST was issued.

failures.test: real HEIC uses document encoding without worker canvas while legacy callers keep the Blob contract
failures.confirmedCause: The last negative legacy variant correctly expected media_heic but returned it as {error: ...}; the WebDriver requester treats that reserved payload key as a protocol error. A local protocol-only probe reproduced the collision.
failures.fixtureCorrection: Rename only the returned test payload key error to failureCode. Preserve the expected media_heic outcome and the real HEIC decoder/worker/CSP paths.

failures.test: real HTTPS/SQL profiles: both roles persist names and avatars, foreign reads fail and removed URLs cannot resurrect
failures.observed: Timed out: the real avatar preparer crops a 256px JPEG before upload.
failures.confirmedCause: The existing helper supplied FileList/change directly without the real chooser intent, as in CHROME-02.
failures.fixtureCorrection: The shared synthetic JPEG helper accepts an optional real chooser selector, intercepts/restores only native input.click, verifies the chooser accepted the opening, then supplies a real FileList/change. The avatar caller passes .profile-choose-avatar; chat photo callers keep their existing path. Real API, SQL, decoder and owner checks remain active.

failures.test: real Chrome + MariaDB: independent client sessions, live text and JPEG, memory draft and exact notification after new login
failures.confirmedCause: The parent is counted failed because its profile subtest failed; this is not a second independent HTTPS failure cause.
